name: Send overdue invoice reminders from Google Sheets with Gmail

parameters.content:
## Send overdue invoice reminders from Google Sheets with Gmail

### Who's it for
Small finance teams, agencies and freelancers who track unpaid invoices in a spreadsheet and chase payments by hand.

### How it works
1. Runs every weekday at 9:00 and reads the **Invoices** sheet.
2. Skips rows whose status is Paid or Cancelled, so reminders stop as soon as you mark an invoice as paid.
3. Sends one reminder per stage (default: due date, +7 and +14 days). The tone gets firmer at each stage and the payment link is included.
4. On day 30 it stops emailing the customer and sends an escalation email to a person on your team instead.
5. Writes the stage and date back to the sheet, so no reminder is ever sent twice.
6. Every Monday it emails an aging report (not due / 0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ days).

### How to set up
1. Copy the sheet layout in the note on the left.
2. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail credentials, then pick your spreadsheet in both sheet nodes.
3. Fill in **Set reminder settings**. Keep **test_mode** on for the first run: all customer emails go to your own address.

### Requirements
Google Sheets and Gmail accounts.

### How to customize
Change **reminder_days** and **escalation_day**, edit the email text in **Pick reminder stage per invoice**, or swap Gmail for Outlook, SMTP or Slack.

### Sheet layout
Tab name: **Invoices**. Header row:

`invoice_id | customer_name | customer_email | amount | currency | due_date | status | payment_link | notes | last_stage_sent | last_sent_at`

- **due_date**: a date cell in any format, or text as YYYY-MM-DD
- **status**: leave empty while open, set to Paid or Cancelled to stop reminders
- **last_stage_sent** and **last_sent_at**: leave empty, the workflow fills them

### Reminder logic
One message per invoice per run. A stage is only sent once, tracked in **last_stage_sent**. From **escalation_day** on, the customer gets no more automatic emails and your team is asked to call.

### Weekly aging report
Runs only on **aging_report_weekday** (1 = Monday) and sends one summary email to the finance inbox.
